artboards.title: The words · masthead line, title, description

annotations.text:
BRAND · issue #135 on the v0.3 map (#121).
The mark is settled: A · The Review, chosen 7 September 2026. The four directions it was chosen against are on the Directions page.
The engraved system of #58 governs: one face, IM Fell English; ink #2b2418 on parchment #efe3c6; the plate's doubled rule; no bold anywhere. The library keeps one look and does not follow the view (map #121), so none of this is themed.

STILL TO DECIDE
1. The masthead line — N1 is drawn on the masthead, the card and the phone; N2, N3 and N4 are beside it on the Words sheet. This is the one that matters most: ADR-0020 left it as the only thing on the page that explains the app.
2. The social card — S1, a real build-time still behind a parchment panel, or S2, the plate alone.
3. Whether the head carries a third line linking to the story, as drawn, or whether that link stays in the credit footer beside the GitHub link.
4. The title and the meta description, T1/T2 and D1/D2.

The masthead is drawn at the real measure and the real ramp: 736px container, 56/24/40 padding, name 30, idea 15 italic, the 3px doubled rule under the head, entries at 20/12 with a 1px hairline between — every value read out of src/app/library.css rather than chosen here. The only new things are the mark, the third line, and the new idea line in place of the concept document's one-liner. Four battles are what the library holds today; grouping at seven is #129, not this ticket.
